question: Laokhowa Wildlife Sanctuary lies on the southern bank of which river in the north-eastern states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brahmaputra**__.

__
 
• **Laokhowa Wildlife Sanctuary lies on the southern bank of the Brahmaputra River.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Laokhowa Wildlife Sanctuary:**

 
 
• It is located in **Assam**.
 
• The sanctuary lies on the southern bank of the Brahmaputra River.
 
• The wildlife sanctuary is a part of the **Laokhowa-Burachapori ecosystem**.
 
• It is an ideal habitat for** Indian rhinoceros and Asiatic water buffaloes. **
 
• Other animals found here are the** royal Bengal tiger, Indian leopard, Indian boar, civet, leopard cat and hog deer.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National parks in Assam** are Kaziranga National Park, Dibru Saikhowa National Park, Orang National Park, **Raimona National Park**, Nameri National Park and Dehing Patkai National Park.
 
• **Wildlife Sanctuaries in Assam** are Hoollongapar Gibbon Sanctuary, Garampani Wildlife Sanctuary, East Karbi-Anglong Wildlife Sanctuary, Sonai Rupai Wildlife Sanctuary and Nambor Wildlife Sanctuary.
